evidence.quote: if (clash) throw new DomainError(409, "overlaps an existing club booking");

rules.statement: A club booking must not overlap an existing club booking on the same date in a conflicting area: a whole-rink booking conflicts with any booking, and half-rink bookings conflict only with the same half.
rules.subject: club booking time slot and rink area

evidence.quote: return { ...b, hours, amountCents: Math.round(hours * factor * this.hourlyRateCents) };

rules.statement: A half-rink club booking is invoiced at half the club hourly rate; a whole-rink booking at the full rate.
rules.subject: club booking invoice rate factor for half rink

evidence.quote: if (input.end <= input.start) throw new DomainError(400, "end must be after start");

rules.statement: A club booking's end time must be later than its start time.
rules.subject: club booking end time

evidence.quote: throw new DomainError(400, "start and end must be whole hours (HH:00)");

rules.statement: Club booking start and end times must be on whole hours (HH:00).
rules.subject: club booking start and end times

evidence.quote: if (!AREAS.includes(input.area)) throw new DomainError(400, "area must be whole, half-a or half-b");

rules.statement: A club booking's area must be the whole rink, half A or half B.
rules.subject: club booking area
